title: Gate: a rule with no severity is counted by its kind
description: The exampleOrg analyzer's rules have a kind but no severity. It reports rule 1 (CODE_SMELL) in each of the 3 files, rule 2 (BUG) in bug_report.bal and rule 3 (VULNERABILITY) in vulnerability_report.bal. The gate counts a BUG as HIGH, a VULNERABILITY as MEDIUM and a CODE_SMELL as LOW. No core rule applies to these files. Needs plugins built after the analyzer learned rules 2 and 3 (npm run setup:plugins). Not available before 0.13.0.

steps.name: No gate
steps.note: 5 issues: 3 of rule 1, 1 of rule 2, 1 of rule 3; exit 0.

steps.name: --fail-on-severity=HIGH
steps.note: Fails: the BUG counts as HIGH.

steps.name: --fail-on-severity=HIGH without the BUG
steps.note: Passes: the VULNERABILITY counts as MEDIUM, below HIGH.

steps.name: --fail-on-severity=MEDIUM --fail-on-count=2
steps.note: Fails: the BUG and the VULNERABILITY make 2.

steps.name: --fail-on-severity=MEDIUM --fail-on-count=3
steps.note: Passes: the CODE_SMELL issues count as LOW.

steps.name: SARIF
steps.note: Shows the level written for each analyzer rule.
